name: whytap
description: Read Whytap state, manage models and settings, add To-do tasks, and find Case projects and key names on this Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Models, settings, To-do, live state and Case key discovery
interface.longDescription: Control the running Whytap app through its bundled local helper. Reads build identity, activity flags, model routes and supported settings. Writes validate the expected current value and use the app's existing settings stores. Case searches authorized project and key names and descriptions, never secret values. Use keys through the existing Case CLI with the client's current access policy.
defaultPrompt: Split my last meeting into tasks and add them to Whytap To-do.
Show the models configured in Whytap.
Set Drop Smart cleanup to the exact model I choose.
Find a key in Whytap Case by its name or description.
